name: Devious Bloodline
body:
You continue to gain spells from your sorcerous bloodline as you advance your skills in trickery.

Prerequisite(s): Sorcerer bloodline class feature, 1st-level Arcane Trickster

Benefit: Your levels in arcane trickster stack with your sorcerer levels for purposes of determining which bloodline spells you know.
